communication.meaning: The courier service receives dispatch instructions from the blood centre and delivers to the hospital. It does not initiate communication; it follows the scheduled shipments.

available.meaning: Shipments occur every Tuesday and Thursday at 4:00 PM America/Los_Angeles.

process_behavior.meaning: The courier service transports blood shipments from the Cascade regional blood centre to St. Vincent regional hospital. A shipment takes about 3 hours from dispatch to receipt at the hospital.
process_behavior.operating_meaning: The courier service operates on Tuesdays and Thursdays, with shipments dispatched at 4:00 PM America/Los_Angeles and received approximately 3 hours later.
process_behavior.rate_meaning: Not applicable; the courier service does not have a rate, it delivers fixed-size shipments.
